meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the existing bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares, considering polarity.

assignments.node_id: שנתגדל השם של זה הצדיק, שהוא בחינת ראש בית
assignments.reason: This is the cause-node describing the enlargement of the Tzaddik's name — its essential nature IS the Tzaddik as rosh bayit, whose name embodies God's name. Package 1 contains ראש בית, שם ה, הצדיק — this node belongs to the same domain of holy Tzaddik-illumination.

The opening of Israel's eyes is the effect of the Tzaddik's revelation. Its essential nature is the restoration of מאור העינים / כח הראות / תלת גונין דעינא — the eye-light domain that is the core of Package 1.

The sustaining of Israel's dwellings is the effect produced by the בעל הבית. Its essential nature is the house/dwelling dimension — Package 1 already contains דירה, בית, בית המקדש. This is the same domain of the Tzaddik sustaining the physical/spiritual dwelling-places.
The sustaining of the Temple is the effect of the בעל הבית's existence. Its essential nature is the Temple — already in Package 1 as בית המקדש. Same domain of holy structure sustained by the Tzaddik.
Near-synonym of קיום והדירות של ישראל. The sustaining of Israel's dwellings through Shabbat belongs to the same dwelling/house domain in Package 1.

Being saved from fires is the positive outcome of Shabbat suppressing מאורי אש. Its essential nature is the protective, preserving dimension of the holy light (מאורי אור subduing fire-lights), which is the core theme of Package 1.

The subduing of the fire-lights describes the evil fire-energy in its diminished state. Its essential nature is the domain of מאורי אש — Package 2. The subduing is an eitza effect, but the node itself describes the fire-lights being conquered, belonging to the evil fire domain.

The mourner is the cause-agent who suppresses fire-lights and restores holy light. Mourning over the Temple is the Torah's prescribed practice — its essential nature is the act of restoring מאורי אור. Package 1 contains the entire domain of holy light, Temple, and the mourning dimension (בכיה, הסתלקות מאורי אור). The mourner belongs to the holy side.
The illumination of the lights of light is the restored state of מאורי אור — the core concept of Package 1. Its essential nature is holy illumination.

Mourning over the Temple is a more specific form of מתאבל. Its essential nature is the act of engaging with the Temple's destruction to restore it — belonging to the Temple/holy-light domain of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: מכניע מאורי אש, ומתגברין מאורי אור
assignments.reason: This compound effect describes the positive outcome: fire-lights subdued and light-of-light strengthened. Its essential nature is the triumph of holy light — the core reality of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: צריך לזהר מאד לקום בחצות, ולהיות מתאבל מאד על חרבן בית המקדש
assignments.reason: The practical directive to rise at midnight and mourn the Temple — this is the eitza advice whose essential nature is the restorative practice of engaging with the Temple/light domain. Package 1 contains the Temple, the mourning, and the holy light that is restored through this practice.

assignments.node_id: לשום לאבלי ציון "פאר תחת אפר" (ישעיה ס"א).
assignments.reason: The promise of 'splendor instead of ashes' — פאר replaces אפר. Its essential nature is the restoration of פאר (splendor/mochin/tefillin), which is a core node of Package 1. The promise describes the holy light replacing the fire-ashes.

assignments.node_id: כשנתגלה הפאר והיפי של הצדיק האמת
assignments.reason: The revelation of the Tzaddik's splendor and beauty is the cause that produces mochin and eye-opening. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik as פאר / יוסף / היפי והפאר של העולם — core concepts in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: נעשין המחין וכח הראות, ונפתחין העינים כנ"ל, אזי יש להעולם בעל הבית, שהוא משגיח על העולם
assignments.reason: This compound effect describes the formation of mochin, the power of sight, the opening of eyes, and the existence of the בעל הבית. Every element (מחין, כח הראות, עינים, בעל הבית) is already a node in Package 1. Its essential nature is the full flowering of the Tzaddik's illumination.
The enlargement of the Tzaddik's name is the cause that enlarges God's name. Its essential nature is שם ה / שם הקדש — the name-domain of Package 1.
The enlargement of God's name is the effect of the Tzaddik's name growing. Its essential nature is שם ה — the divine name, core of Package 1.
The revelation of the Tzaddik is the cause of being able to see God's greatness. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik (צדיק האמת, הצדיק) — Package 1.

assignments.node_id: יכול לראות ולהסתכל בגדלת השם ולהסתכל בעולם
assignments.reason: The ability to see and gaze at God's greatness and at the world is the effect of the Tzaddik's revelation. Its essential nature is כח הראות / מאור העינים — the seeing-capacity domain of Package 1.
Drawing close to the true Tzaddik is the cause of eyes opening. Its essential nature is the relationship with the Tzaddik — the צדיק האמת / צדיק יסוד עולם domain of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: נפתחין עיניו, ורואה ומסתכל על עצמו, איך הוא אוחז בכל המדות
assignments.reason: The opening of one's eyes and self-examination of character traits is the effect of drawing close to the Tzaddik. Its essential nature is the eye-opening / כח הראות domain of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: כשזה הצדיק, שהוא היפי של כל העולם, נתפרסם ונתגדל בעולם
assignments.reason: The Tzaddik, who is the beauty of the entire world, becoming famous and great — this is a variant of כשנתגלה הפאר והיפי. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik as היפי והפאר של העולם — Package 1.
The opening of the world's eyes is the effect of the Tzaddik's fame. Its essential nature is מאור העינים / כח הראות — the eye-light domain of Package 1.

Weeping is the cause that produces the setting of light and withdrawal of eye-light. Package 1 already contains בכיה (crying) and הסתלקות מאורי אור (withdrawal of light) as bechina-equivalent nodes. בכי is the same concept as בכיה — they share the same essential nature of holy weeping in exile.

analysis_notes.eitza_flow_summary: The Torah's cause/effect flow runs in two directions: (1) Positive: Tzaddik revealed [Pkg 1] → eyes open [Pkg 1] → Tzaddik's name grows → God's name grows [Pkg 1]; Shabbat [Pkg 1] → subdues fire [Pkg 2] → preserves dwellings [Pkg 1]. (2) Negative: Weeping [Pkg 1] → light withdraws → fire grows [Pkg 2]. (3) Restorative: Mourning at midnight [Pkg 1] → subdues fire [Pkg 2] → restores splendor [Pkg 1].
analysis_notes.structural_note: Almost all cause/effect nodes fall into Package 1 because the Torah's causal chain operates entirely within the single domain of Tzaddik/light/Temple. The only cross-package flow is the suppression of מאורי אש (Package 2) by the holy practices and by Shabbat. The node נכנעין מאורי אש was placed in Package 2 (evil) because its essential nature is the fire-lights themselves, even though their subduing is a positive event.
